title: MSAA path-activation + edge-AA-band SMOKE (v0.1; per-mode profile deferred to v0.2)
purpose: Render one solid-WHITE triangle (60,60)-(60,420)-(580,240) on a solid-BLACK background. The two diagonal edges advance ~0.346 px/px in y across x∈[60..580], so every column places the edge at a distinct sub-pixel position. The XBE itself is MSAA-agnostic; the host renderer's XEMU_METAL_MSAA flag governs whether the edge resolves to a hard step (msaa=0) or to a per-coverage gradient (msaa=2/4). v0.1 NARROWED SCOPE per Codex 2026-05-21 finding: this is a MSAA path-activation + edge-AA-band PRESENT smoke test, NOT the full per-mode gradient-profile test §4.15 ultimately specifies. The math-derived oracle is the HARD-STEP rasterization: interior pixels are byte-exact (255,255,255,255), exterior pixels are byte-exact (0,0,0,255), and the edge boundary band is tolerated via compare_overrides. v0.1 catches: (a) MSAA path never engaged (required_counters_min asserts METAL_MSAA_RESOLVE_COUNT >= 100 AND METAL_MSAA_SAMPLE_COUNT >= 12 on every Metal cell — both the canonical msaa=2 cell and the msaa=4 variant); (b) MSAA resolve writes garbage into non-edge tiles (interior/exterior signal-region byte-check fails); (c) geometry mis-rasterized to the wrong cover region (signal_match drops below threshold); (d) front-face culling regression (triangle vanishes); (e) sample-count silently coerced to 1 despite XEMU_METAL_MSAA=2/4 (METAL_MSAA_SAMPLE_COUNT sum would fall to ~12 not >=24). v0.1 does NOT catch (DEFERRED to v0.2 per the Codex finding adopted in decision-log 2026-05-21): per-mode profile differentiation (msaa=2 silently collapsing to msaa=4 still passes today because both share the any/any/any hard-step oracle); positive lower-bound on the AA-band pixel count (a renderer that keeps resolve plumbing alive but renders the triangle as a hard step still passes today because changed_pct only has an UPPER bound). v0.2 adds per-mode keyed expected_results + an edge-band occupancy lower-bound assertion. Also does NOT catch: exact per-sample positions (Apple Silicon's standard 4× pattern is not bit-identical to NV2A's; spec only requires monotone coverage); depth-aware MSAA resolve modes — both deferred to a separate Tier-2 sample-position XBE.
